create_transition_batch: create a TransitionBatch dataclass instance with obs, act, next_obs, rewards, terminateds, and truncateds tensors
use_astuple: use the TransitionBatch astuple method to convert a batch into a 6-element transition tuple
index_transition_batch: index a TransitionBatch with __getitem__ to extract a subset of transitions by slice or index
reshape_batch_dim: use add_new_batch_dim on a TransitionBatch to reshape transitions into a new nested batch dimension
use_type_aliases: use RewardFnType, TermFnType, ObsProcessFnType, TensorType, and ModelInput type aliases for MBRL function signatures
